name: Zero Gravity Shuffle
concept: Footwork that looks like it's happening in low gravity: glides with no visible push-off, suspended off-axis balances, and one big comedic 'gravity returns' drop. Smoothness is the hook; the drop is the punchline.
hook: Feet glide, body floats — then gravity remembers you.
firstSecond: Both feet slide half a metre sideways with no visible step while the shoulders rise, as if weight has just switched off.

sequence.name: Lift-off
sequence.description: Sideways heel-toe slide, shoulders rise, arms drift up with palms down.

sequence.name: Drift
sequence.description: Continuous heel-toe glides left and right; arms float at shoulder height.

sequence.name: Gravity returns
sequence.description: Exaggerated drop: knees bend deep, arms slam down, springy recovery bounce.

sequence.name: Back-glide
sequence.description: Backward heel-toe glide, torso upright and calm.

sequence.name: Re-float
sequence.description: Shoulders rise again, settling into the Lift-off stance.

signature: The Suspend: standing on one leg, other knee raised, whole body leaning ~15° off-axis and held as if floating in orbit.
loopPoint: Re-float ends in the exact Lift-off stance, feet together, so the slide restarts seamlessly.
cameraGuidance: Locked-off camera at hip height, slightly wider framing than usual so lateral glides stay in frame. Smooth floor, contrasting shoes.
motionTransferConsiderations: Feet are the identity of this move: shoes must contrast with the floor and never leave frame.
Keep glides under ~0.6s each; very fast foot work tends to smear in motion transfer.
The gravity drop should stay upright — no floor contact with hands or knees.
generationGuidance: Motion from an owned reference performance only. Emphasise feet visibility in the prompt. Character orientation from video. Reference audio off.

referenceCapture.performerBrief: One performer on a smooth floor (socks or slick-soled shoes) performs lateral and backward heel-toe glides, a held one-leg float and an exaggerated drop-and-bounce. Keep glides controlled, not fast.
referenceCapture.wardrobe: Shoes that contrast strongly with the floor; trousers that don't cover the ankles; fitted top.
referenceCapture.framing: Portrait 9:16, slightly wide so lateral travel stays in frame, feet never cropped, plain background.
